## Retained changes

- Separate scaled even-rotation values from their input coefficients. Keep the column even sum as a signed `int`; both `int` and `s32` are 32-bit in this ABI.
- Hoist the existing pass locals and name them by row/column role. Declaration order controls the allocator without extra runtime operations.
- Put DC shift/bias calculations inside `clampLumaDc` and `clampChromaDc`. Their inlined DC paths now have the target load and flag registers.
- Scope `optimization_level 3` to Lumi with push/pop. Its math and branch structure are preserved; the column pass becomes exact with the solved declaration order.
- Commute the two inputs to the row even-rotation sum. This removes one additional operand difference.

Source and target contain only the two requested functions, in the same order: Lumi at `0x000`, size `0x404`; Col at `0x404`, size `0x718`. Both `.text` sections are 2844 bytes. The only undefined symbol in either object is `memset`. The pools contain zero strings and match.

## Coverage

The trial history records each compiled result or source hash. Source searches logged 14990 compiled candidate measurements across both functions. Additional rounds covered scoped optimization options, signed scalar types, declaration order and scope, legal assignment swaps, coefficient/rotation reuse, real math/clamp helper boundaries, constant locals, commutative expressions, whole rotation-group ordering, and a related even sum/rotation return type. The aggregate-return forms added 16 bytes of code and were rejected. Ten fresh permutation captures each received a separate allocator search. The final source was recaptured and replayed independently.

GC 3.0a3, a3.2, a3.3, a3.4 and a5 produce the same retained bytes as a5.2. Wii 1.0/1.3/1.7 regress the candidates. `__srawi` and `__sraw` are undefined external calls in this compiler and were rejected. Earlier unsigned coefficient/sample and redundant-condition trials were rejected on source-quality or semantic grounds.
